Name: VCT - Pink Wizard Furniture Recolor (CP and AT)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Well, one day I had a long day at work and thought to myself "How would the wizard furniture look in pink?" and oddly enough it was a vibe. So...I decided to make a CP version of it.

Maybe one day  an AT version too but cutting the sheet is annoying...

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Generally Compatible. CP version is NOT compatible with other CP mods that edit the Wizard Furniture. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3NSVKgHr/title2-1-see-also.png[/img]
